newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Maltese tanker runs aground in western Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: Maltese tanker runs aground in western Venezuela.

text.p: A Maltese-flagged tanker ran aground Thursday in Venezuela's Lake Maracaibo at the same site where two tankers grounded late last month, Maracaibo's harbour master said.
No oil spill was reported from the Corelli which was en route to state-oil company PdVSA's refinery in Curacao with a 33,000 tonne cargo of crude, harbour master Adolfo Alvarez told Reuters.
Alvarez said he expected the boat would be refloated with the rising tide at 1900 local/2300 GMT. Normal shipping would resume with the next high tide.
On average, some 1.5 million barrels of oil are shipped from Lake Maracaibo daily.
